{{Quote|Master, because someone erased it from the archive memory.|Burtola trying to explain why [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] didn't show on the archives|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''J. K. Burtola''' was a four-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] old [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] enrolled in the [[Jedi academy|academy]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A member of the [[Bear Clan]], he was one of its brightest members.

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], J.K. Burtola was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and given over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Assigned to the mighty [[Bear Clan]], an [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Initiate Clan]] whose members were known for their bravery, Initiate Burtola received his earliest instruction from clan leader, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="CSWE" />

During one of the clan's daily [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] instructional courses on the [[Jedi Temple veranda|Temple's veranda]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] approached Grand Master Yoda with a question; it appeared the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple's Archives]] were incomplete and missing a [[Kamino system/Legends|system]]. With permission from Master Yoda, Initiate Burtola suggested that someone had erased the files, therefore explaining the Archives' seeming incompleteness.<ref name="AOTC" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Portrayed by [[Alex Knoll]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], J. K. Burtola was the only Jedi child that was given a speaking part in the final version of the film. In earlier drafts, he was identified as "Jedi Child Jack" in the script.<ref name="speaking">{{DB|organization|bearclan|Bear Clan}}</ref>
